display_title: Happily Ever After with the Second Male Lead
description:
Who would ever believe a cat could talk? All I did was vent a little frustration to a stray cat on the street, but then...

\[This is a reward reserved only for kind humans! Quick, tell me! Is that your wish, meow?\]

 *"I mean, if it were me, I would’ve done it like this! I would’ve...!"*

\[Done! I shall grant your wish, meow!\]

Suddenly, I’ve been transmigrated into my favorite novel—ten years after its ending! But since I’m here, I might as well live happily ever after with my "bias"! Will she be able to claim her happy ending?

(Source: Manta)

*Note: Part of Metatoon's Sunjeong Danpyeonseon (순정 단편선) Collection.*
